description:
Hushfeed v0.31.0 targets global TikTok 46.2.3 (com.zhiliaoapp.musically).

Double-tap controls set to do nothing no longer like the video, Ghost mode no longer closes the app when a story is opened, and Playback quality stops putting an error over every video on builds whose model getter returns nothing. Remove feed ads reads TikTok's raw auction metadata and the creator commission disclosure across the feed, profile, Friends, search and late-insertion routes. The exported diagnostic report counts every feed filter route whether or not logging is on, so an ad report can say which route delivered the ad. Every setting that needs a restart says so, the About row shows the installed version, and eight optional optimizer patches from Kveld are built in and off by default.

Validation: 1213 runtime tests passed locally, plus 178 in the patches module. The bundle carries 79 patches and all three DEX payloads are non-empty. Both Android API checks passed. All patches applied with zero failures to the 46.2.3, 46.7.3 and 46.8.3 fixtures. Needs Morphe Manager 1.29.0 or newer.

The downloadable .mpp is the patch bundle. Patch on the device with Morphe Manager and keep its existing signing key.
